_standing: 2026-09-25 - step 11, experiment T1 (entry 156, H096 P4-31). The case configuration for running iteration 4's Track 2 chain on Bloom syndrome. Public knowledge only: no allele in any person is asserted, nothing comes from the MVA proband's record. Every identifier and PMID was resolved live on 2026-09-25 (Monarch v3 entity API for MONDO, NCBI E-utilities esummary for PubMed). Written before any stage ran. Coordinate-free by rule.
picked_by: docs/iteration4/step-11/README.md (a different gene, pathway and clinical term list; the same kind of question)

case._mondo_verified: GET https://api-v3.monarchinitiative.org/v3/api/entity/MONDO:0008876 on 2026-09-25: name 'Bloom syndrome', xrefs OMIM:210900 and Orphanet:125. PrimeKG 2.1 holds one disease node whose x_id member list contains 8876 (x_name 'Bloom syndrome', x_source MONDO)

hpo_source.rule: every aspect-P row for OMIM:210900 whose qualifier is not NOT, file order, deduplicated (mva.phenotype.cross_species_io.parse_disease_terms, the reader entry 150's controls use)
hpo_source.rows: 45 rows for the disease: 42 aspect P, 2 aspect C, 1 aspect I; 0 NOT rows

case.tumour_context: haematological malignancy (leukemia and lymphoma): 83 of 251 neoplasms (33 %) in the Bloom Syndrome Registry, more common than any single solid tumour (PMID 35420546, Sugranes 2022, Genet Med)

gene.protein: BLM, a RecQ-family DNA helicase (the BTR 'dissolvasome' with TOP3A, RMI1, RMI2)
gene._source: PMID 28232778 (Cunniff 2017, Mol Syndromol): loss-of-function BLM mutations cause Bloom syndrome; chromosome instability, excess homologous recombination, sister chromatid exchanges

mechanism.class: loss-of-function, biallelic (public literature; this card asserts no variant in any person)
mechanism.pathway: homologous recombination / replication-stress resolution (BLM-TOP3A-RMI1-RMI2 dissolution of double Holliday junctions)
downstream: elevated sister chromatid exchange and mitotic recombination
somatic loss of heterozygosity (LOH) by mitotic recombination - the cancer mechanism in Bloom mice (PMID 11101838, Luo 2000, Nat Genet)
growth restriction, immune deficiency, early and multiple cancers (PMID 20301572, GeneReviews)

repurposing_directions.name: genome-instability stress: lines with high LOH fraction
tumour context: haematological malignancy (leukemia, lymphoma)
repurposing_directions._contrast_note: the sweep's lineage contrast tag is the hard-coded key 'rms' in src/mva/drugs/screen_sweep_run.py; in this case it holds the haematological lines (entry 156, gap 5)

repurposing_directions.name: a published intervention in a Blm mouse (phenotype twin)

twin._pathway_why: the BTR complex partners (RMI2 loss: Bloom-like syndrome, PMID 27977684; TOP3A: Bloom syndrome-like disorder, PMID 30057030) and the two other RecQ helicases with their own syndromes (Werner, Rothmund-Thomson)
twin._controls_why: entry 150's calibration panel, unchanged: it does not depend on the query, so a re-run is a determinism check against entry 150

sweep._in_group_rule: every non-null OncotreeCode of DepMap Model_24Q4 OncotreeLineage Lymphoid or Myeloid, except PCM (plasma cell myeloma) and MDS (myelodysplastic syndrome): the registry names leukemia and lymphoma (PMID 35420546)
sweep._annotation_why: Bloom's cancer mechanism is LOH by mitotic recombination (PMID 11101838); DepMap OmicsSignatures 24Q4 LoHFraction is the matching line-level annotation. Aneuploidy (MVA's) is not the Bloom phenotype
sweep._control_exclude_why: entry 151's list is kept (generically toxic or MVA-biology classes) and the DNA-damage / replication-stress classes are added, so the negative band holds drugs unrelated to either case's biology

lincs._control_why: BLM's own complex partners; loss of RMI2 or TOP3A gives a Bloom-like syndrome (PMIDs 27977684, 30057030), so their knockdown / knockout signatures should mimic BLM loss

k1.source: PMID 20301572 (GeneReviews, Bloom syndrome, updated 2023): 'Alkylating agents and radiation therapy are considered high risk and are avoided when possible'; 'dose reductions and shortened courses of chemotherapy when needed'. Do-not = the alkylating class; caution = the other DNA-damaging and replication-stress classes (Repurposing Hub MOA vocabulary)

k2.genome: not run: there is no patient genome for this case (pgx_summary.json declares no gene)
